mapper.sql: u.user_id,u.lgn_id,u.pswd_hash,u.email_addr,u.user_stts_cd,u.rsgn_dt, (u.mfa_yn='Y' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.user_role ur JOIN sys.role r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=u.user_id AND r.admin_yn='Y' AND r.use_yn='Y')) AS mfa, u.pswd_chg_need_yn='Y' AS change_required,u.pswd_chg_at,u.otp_fail_cnt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys.user_info u WHERE u.lgn_id=#{loginId}
SELECT FROM sys.user_info u WHERE u.user_id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE OF u
mapper.update: UPDATE sys.user_info SET otp_fail_cnt=LEAST(5,otp_fail_cnt+1) WHERE user_id=#{userId}
UPDATE sys.auth_tkn SET revoked_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND use_at IS NULL
UPDATE sys.auth_tkn SET use_at=#{now} WHERE tkn_id=#{id} AND use_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expir_at > #{now}
UPDATE sys.login_session SET revoked_at=#{now} WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
UPDATE sys.login_session SET revoked_at=#{now} WHERE session_id_hash=#{hash} AND revoked_at IS NULL

UPDATE sys.login_session SET last_activity_at=#{now},expires_at=#{now}+INTERVAL '30 minutes' WHERE session_id_hash=#{hash} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at > #{now} AND last_activity_at > #{now}-INTERVAL '30 minutes'

UPDATE sys.user_info SET pswd_hash=#{hash},pswd_chg_at=#{now},pswd_chg_need_yn='N',lgn_fail_cnt=0,otp_fail_cnt=0, user_stts_cd=CASE WHEN user_stts_cd='LOCKED' THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE user_stts_cd END,lock_at=NULL WHERE user_id=#{userId}
mapper.select: INSERT INTO sys.auth_request_window(key_hash,window_start,request_count) VALUES(#{hash},#{now},1) ON CONFLICT(key_hash) DO UPDATE SET window_start=CASE WHEN sys.auth_request_window.window_start <= #{now}-INTERVAL '15 minutes' THEN #{now} ELSE sys.auth_request_window.window_start END, request_count=CASE WHEN sys.auth_request_window.window_start <= #{now}-INTERVAL '15 minutes' THEN 1 ELSE sys.auth_request_window.request_count+1 END RETURNING request_count
mapper.update: UPDATE sys.mail_outbox SET send_stts_cd='SENT',sent_at=#{now} WHERE mail_outbox_id=#{id}
